description: Confirmatory exposure-response coefficients: 13 cohort-outcome combinations x 4 spermatogenic windows x 3 exposure metrics.

sources.kind: model coefficients, standard errors, P and BH q values
SD-to-native-unit conversion of the same coefficients

notes: Coefficients are in within-cohort standard-deviation units of the outcome. Confidence intervals are beta +/- 1.96 x SE.
anyhw3 and hwp95 are binary in this family: the coefficient is the exposed-versus-unexposed contrast, not a per-day slope.
q values are Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted across all 156 tests of the two-cohort family, not within cohort or outcome.
Native-unit effects are available for the subset of rows that have a matching within-cohort standard deviation in the locked sample.

anyhw3.label: Any heatwave in window (>=3 consecutive days Tmax >=35 C)

hwp95.label: Any heatwave in window (>=3 consecutive days Tmax >= warm-season 95th percentile)

ht30.label: Days with Tmax >=30 C in window

ht32.label: Days with Tmax >=32 C in window

ht35.label: Days with Tmax >=35 C in window

hw2.label: Heatwave days, >=2 consecutive days Tmax >=35 C

hw3.label: Heatwave days, >=3 consecutive days Tmax >=35 C

hw4.label: Heatwave days, >=4 consecutive days Tmax >=35 C

ht35_w0_90.label: Days with Tmax >=35 C, 0-90 d window

ht32_w0_90.label: Days with Tmax >=32 C, 0-90 d window

ht30_w0_90.label: Days with Tmax >=30 C, 0-90 d window

models.m1: Ordinary least squares on the within-cohort standardised outcome, with donor-level cluster-robust standard errors; covariates: donor age, abstinence days, season (categorical) and centred calendar year. Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the 156-test two-cohort confirmatory family.
